section_01_motivacao.rationale: Domain mismatch. Template discusses ERP/ML features. Must rewrite for industrial IoT/predictive maintenance context. Focus on INCM manufacturing sealing/laminating equipment challenges.
key_topics: Lack of predictive capability in production lines
Business case: maintenance cost reduction through prediction
